subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Control UI for Multi-Agent + Subagent Orchestration (Hierarchy, Bulk Ops, and Scalability)

question: Should this runtime subagent orchestration view be a dedicated Control UI surface, folded into Sessions/Tasks/Workboard/modular dashboard, or deferred as too close to a heavy orchestration layer?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but VISION.md supports web frontend ergonomics while warning against heavy orchestration layers, so automation cannot choose the durable product surface or bulk-action safety model.

options.title: Stage Read-Only Hierarchy First
options.body: Approve a first slice that renders existing session/task lineage and active/failed/completed state without privileged bulk actions, then review bulk controls separately.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Pages
options.body: Constrain the work to Sessions, Tasks, Workboard, or modular dashboard widgets to avoid another top-level surface, accepting the chosen model's limitations.

options.title: Defer Core UI Work
options.body: Keep or close the request by maintainer decision if this is considered a heavy orchestration layer outside current core priorities.

recommendation.title: Stage Read-Only Hierarchy First
recommendation.body: Approve a first slice that renders existing session/task lineage and active/failed/completed state without privileged bulk actions, then review bulk controls separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active modular-dashboard roadmap that now partially overlaps this dashboard direction, making them the best available routing candidate for narrowing how it should interact with that stack before broader maintainer approval.
